refLaserWavelengthUm._comment: Reference laser wavelength in micrometers. Default: 1.550

zeroPadK._comment: Zero-padding factor (0-16). Output bins = N*(K+1). 0 = no padding.

apodizationWindow._comment: Apodization window: Rectangular, Gauss, Triangular, NortonBeer, DolphChebyshev

gaussSigma._comment: Gauss sigma fraction (1.0-3.0). Only used when apodizationWindow = Gauss.

rectWidth._comment: Rectangular window width fraction (0.05-1.0). Only used when apodizationWindow = Rectangular.

detectorSensitivityKVperW._comment: Detector sensitivity in kV/W. 0 = skip conversion.

xUnit._comment: X axis unit: cm-1, um, THz

yAxisMode._comment: Y axis mode: all, tight, force

forcedYMin._comment: Forced Y axis minimum. Only used when yAxisMode = force.

forcedYMax._comment: Forced Y axis maximum. Only used when yAxisMode = force.

xUnit._comment: X axis unit for average plot: cm-1, um, THz

yScale._comment: Y scale for average plot: lin, log10, dB

yAxisMode._comment: Y axis mode: all, tight, force

forcedYMin._comment: Forced Y axis minimum for average.

forcedYMax._comment: Forced Y axis maximum for average.

xUnit._comment: X axis unit for SNR plot: cm-1, um, THz

yScale._comment: Y scale for SNR plot: lin, log10

yAxisMode._comment: Y axis mode: all, tight, force

forcedYMin._comment: Forced Y axis minimum for SNR.

forcedYMax._comment: Forced Y axis maximum for SNR.

xUnit._comment: X axis unit for Allan plot: cm-1, um, THz

wavelengthDecimation._comment: Spectral decimation factor (1-50). Higher = faster but coarser.

xRangeMinUm._comment: Minimum X range for Allan calculation in um.

xRangeMaxUm._comment: Maximum X range for Allan calculation in um.

sliceIndex._comment: Slice index for 2D view (0 = first wavelength bin).

xUnit._comment: X axis unit for 100% T: cm-1, um, THz

csvReferencePath._comment: Path to reference CSV file. Only used when referenceSource = CSV.

yAxisMode._comment: Y axis mode: all, tight, force

forcedYMin._comment: Forced Y axis minimum for 100% T.

forcedYMax._comment: Forced Y axis maximum for 100% T.

workerThreads._comment: Number of worker threads (-1 = AUTO, otherwise 1/2/4/8/16).
